en: I drew a pretty flower on the paper.
I didn't draw a big tree yesterday.
You drew a big house with the pencil.
You didn't draw the door of the house.
You drew a little cat today.
You didn't draw the sun in the sky.
He drew a sea on the canvas.
He didn't draw the map of the city.
She drew a beautiful face with oil paints.
She didn't draw her family.
We drew a big mountain at school.
We didn't draw the man's mouth.
You drew a very small car.
You didn't draw the tower in the notebook.
They drew an airplane in the sky.

lat: l-drari ma resmush l-7ewli dyal l-3id
ar: الدراري ما رسموش الحولي ديال العيد
en: The children didn't draw the holiday ram.

lat: ana kanrsem kul nhar f d-dar
en: I draw every day at home.
I don't draw difficult things now.
You draw animals well.
You don't draw well with colors.
You always draw red roses.
You don't draw the whole night.
He draws the street from the window.

lat: huwa ma kayrsemsh f d-defter dyali
en: He does not draw in my notebook.
She draws a picture of her brother.
She does not draw with a lead pencil.
We are drawing our school now.

lat: ma kanresmush f l-bit dyal d-dyaf
en: We do not draw in the guest room.
You draw flowers in the classroom.
You don't draw a lot in the morning.
They draw the tables in the workshop.
The students do not draw on the wall.
I am going to draw a big elephant tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish nrsem walu had l-3shiya
ar: ما غاديش نرسم والو هاد العشية
en: I will not draw anything this evening.

lat: nta ghadi trsem l-fer7a f l-werqa
en: You are going to draw joy on the paper.

lat: ma ghadish trsem d-dar dyal jeddi
ar: ما غاديش ترسم الدار ديال جدي
en: You are not going to draw my grandfather's house.
You (f.) are going to draw a nice picture tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish tresmi l-wjeh dyal sa7bti
ar: ما غاديش ترسمي الوجه ديال صاحبتي
en: You will not draw my friend's face.

ar: هو غادي يرسم جبل عالي غدا
en: He is going to draw a high mountain tomorrow.
He will not draw tonight.

lat: hiya ghadi trsem shejra dyal l-limun
ar: هي غادي ترسم شجرة ديال الليمون
en: She is going to draw a lemon tree.

lat: ma ghadish trsem b had l-qlem
en: She will not draw with this pen.
We are going to draw the city on the paper.

lat: ma ghadish nresmu l-berrani f d-dar
en: We will not draw the stranger at home.

lat: ntuma ghadi tresmu teswira zwina l l-ustad
ar: نتوما غادي ترسمو تصويرة زوينة للأستاذ
en: You are going to draw a nice picture for the teacher.

lat: ma ghadish tresmu f had l-werqa
en: You are not going to draw on this sheet of paper.

lat: huma ghadi yresmu l-bab dyal l-mdina
ar: هما غادي يرسمو الباب ديال المدينة
en: They are going to draw the gate of the city.

lat: ma ghadish yresmu f l-werqa l-kbira
en: They will not draw on the big sheet of paper.
